scope: The 861 open incompatibilities reported by the insurance-coverage panel
note: The crosswalk `reason` column is varchar(40), so each ruling below carries a short label there and its full rationale here.

structural_resolutions.root_cause: nfi.parse_detail split «ترکیبات» with a name pattern of [A-Za-z \-/+.]*, which admits no comma, bracket, colon, parenthesis or digit. Every substance whose printed name contains one lost its dose at parse time even though the page stated it.
examples: Vitamin K1 10 mg  (digit in the name)
structural_resolutions.fix: backfill.strength_from_composition locates the DOSE instead of the name; wired into nfi.parse_detail for future harvests and applied retroactively to rows already held.
structural_resolutions.validation: 98.2% agreement against 38,552 rows that already carry a strength (97.6% exact, 0.3% same dose set); the widened dose vocabulary left the generic_full path unchanged at 98.1%.
structural_resolutions.why_not_more: A sibling-strength heuristic was rejected: composition states brigatinib 180 mg on one row and 90 mg on another, so inferring from an agreeing sibling would have written 90 mg on both. Alunbrig is 30/90/180 mg and sirolimus 0.5/1/2 mg — one agreeing sibling proves nothing.
structural_resolutions.deliberately_left_empty: Products that print no dose anywhere: AMYL NITRITE, ACETIC ACID, NITROUS OXIDE (pure substances), «Immune Globulin» on the antivenoms (potency is expressed as venom neutralised per vial, not as a concentration), and APREMILAST whose page covers 10/20/30 mg together. An invented strength would be worse than the gap.

structural_resolutions.root_cause: For a fixed-dose combination NFI states only the FIRST ingredient in «نام ژنریک» and writes the rest into the dose (generic_name='empagliflozin', strength='10 mg/LINAGLIPTIN 5 mg'). The record advertised one ingredient while being a two-ingredient product, so match()'s ingredient-set guard — right to demand agreement in both directions — refused candidates agreeing on molecule set, form AND dose.
structural_resolutions.fix: structural_match.record_components reads the full ingredient list from monograph.generic_full (which names every ingredient ahead of the form) and from the strength string (gated on the known vocabulary).

also_fixed.defect: «PIPERACILLIN 4 g» matched a piperacillin/tazobactam record at 0.93 — above the auto-apply line — because the record understated itself. A patient entitled to piperacillin alone would have been quoted Tazocin.
also_fixed.status: closed by the same change; regression test test_a_mono_row_never_lands_on_a_combination

second_defect.defect: doses_agree asks whether two sides share ANY dose. For a combination that is far too weak: «EMPAGLIFLOZIN / LINAGLIPTIN 10 mg/5 mg» matched a 25 mg/5 mg record on the shared 5, offering a 25 mg tablet against a 10 mg entitlement.
second_defect.fix: doses_agree_all requires every dose on each side to have a partner; used whenever the row is a combination.

structural_resolutions.correctly_still_unmatched: Stalevo 125 (levodopa 125 / carbidopa 31.25 / entacapone 200) is a real product absent from our catalog. It must NOT fall back to the 200 mg tablet on the shared entacapone 200.

structural_resolutions.root_cause: A cause was closed only by a `*` ruling — correct, since price_gap_extreme must never be blanket-silenced. But the counts are pure SQL, so a row ruled INDIVIDUALLY went on being counted forever: both spliced monographs were accepted per-IRC and the board still read 2.
structural_resolutions.fix: issue_registry.ruled_subjects; per-row accepted/resolved/wont_fix subjects leave the count. `deferred` deliberately does not — it records postponed work, not a settled question.
structural_resolutions.care: `moderate` is derived as any_gap − extreme, so a row ruled at the extreme tier is excluded from BOTH queries; otherwise ruling it merely demoted it into the moderate bucket and the total never fell.

price_gap_extreme.verdict: accepted — basis mismatch, not a price error
price_gap_extreme.evidence: In every row the reference/announced ratio equals the package count: betamethasone ×600 (pack 500), terbutaline ×40 (50), cycloserine ×33 (30), methylphenidate ×32 (30), thiopental ×23 (25), imiquimod ×23 (24), sodium chloride ×19 (21), sulfadiazine ×18 (20), pantoprazole ×12 (14), imiquimod ×11 (12). Normalised to a common basis every gap falls within 0.86–1.24.
price_gap_extreme.tested_before_generalising: The hypothesis that the insurer reference is ALWAYS package-based was measured across all 45,797 priced coverage entries and REFUTED: the reference agrees with the UNIT price for 47.5% within ±11% and with the package price for only 0.3%. These 12 are per-row exceptions, so each was ruled individually rather than by a blanket rule that would silence genuinely wrong prices.

coverage_review_conflict.rationale: «لوودوپا-ب» is levodopa + benserazide (Madopar); FORTE is the 200/50 strength. The conflict flag fired only because the insurer's name never spells out the second molecule.
«لوودوپا-ث» is levodopa + carbidopa (Sinemet); FORTE is the 250/25 strength.
Naphazoline HCl 0.05% + antazoline phosphate 0.5% ophthalmic drops — the same product.

Prostaglandin F2α is dinoprost; dinoprostone is PGE2. Two different prostaglandins with different clinical use — postpartum haemorrhage and mid-trimester termination versus cervical ripening. The dose disagrees too (5 vs 10 mg/mL). We hold no dinoprost at all; the only PGF2α analogue in the catalog is carboprost 250 µg/mL (همابیت). The row is a genuine catalog gap, not a match.
coverage_review_conflict.safety: clinically material — these are not interchangeable

coverage_review_conflict.was_matched_to: 1842455574163964 cefazolin 250 mg INJECTION, POWDER, FOR SOLUTION
coverage_review_conflict.rationale: Cephalexin is the oral first-generation cephalosporin; cefazolin is the parenteral one. Different drug and different route. We do hold cephalexin monohydrate (250 and 500 mg capsules, 125 mg/5 mL suspension), but the insurer row states neither dose nor form, so it is a molecule-level heading that cannot be pinned to one presentation. Rejecting stops the cefazolin link without fabricating a cephalexin one.
coverage_review_conflict.safety: clinically material — a parenteral product must not be dispensed against an oral entitlement
coverage_review_conflict.note: The wrong link arrived via the national-code join at 0.72, which suggests a code collision worth a separate look.

nfi_missing_strength.why: These state no dose in name, composition or monograph title. Some are legitimately strength-less (gases, antivenoms, pure substances, cream bases) and some need the source.
nfi_missing_strength.next: Re-crawl the ~27,000 uncrawled NFI ids and the 631 retryable failures — blocked on the Iran proxy.

coverage_unmatched_researchable.note: The 32 include DROPPER 10CC, GELATIN CAPSUL, CREAM BASE (COLD CREAM) and ostomy lotions — devices and excipient bases mis-laned as research because the device regex does not name them. GASEOUS GANGRENE ANTITOXIN in the same group is a real biological and must not be swept in with them.
